sources.title: Training Execution | tokenbender/avataRL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers the primary entrypoints and execution methods for running avataRL training. It focuses on the orchestration layer that manages process initialization, distributed coordination, and handoff to the core training system.

sources.title: Utilities and Scripts | tokenbender/agent-guides | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers the supporting Python utilities that enable the custom commands system, particularly the session extraction script that forms the foundation of the memory management workflow. These utilities handle the low-level data processing tasks required for session history management and conversation analysis.
